# Medley Innovation

> Medley Innovation is a Las Vegas, Nevada-based provider of WIOA-aligned financial literacy and workforce development programs for nonprofits, workforce agencies, employers, and communities. Programs are delivered in person across Southern Nevada and virtually nationwide via Zoom, and are structured to align with grant funding (WIOA, CDFI Fund, HUD, CRA, SBA, CSBG).

## Who we serve
- [Financial Literacy Workshops for Nonprofits & Agencies](https://medleyinnovation.com/financial-literacy-for-nonprofits.html): Turnkey financial education programs with curriculum, facilitators, and outcome reporting.
- [Employee Financial Wellness Workshops](https://medleyinnovation.com/employee-financial-wellness.html): Workplace financial education for employers, on-site in Las Vegas or virtual.
- [Financial Literacy Classes in Las Vegas](https://medleyinnovation.com/financial-literacy-classes-las-vegas.html): In-person classes across Southern Nevada.

## Programs
- [Community Financial Wellness](https://medleyinnovation.com/community-wellness.html): Family financial literacy, homeownership readiness, credit building, and fraud prevention.
- [Workforce Financial Readiness](https://medleyinnovation.com/workforce-readiness.html): Banking, budgeting, credit, and payroll literacy for job seekers and employees.
- [Career & Employment Readiness](https://medleyinnovation.com/career-readiness.html): Resume development, interview prep, workplace professionalism, and job retention.
- [Entrepreneurship Financial Education](https://medleyinnovation.com/entrepreneurship.html): Startup financial planning, business credit, and access to capital.
- [Youth & Teen Financial Literacy](https://medleyinnovation.com/youth-financial-literacy.html): Teen financial bootcamps, first-job readiness, and student banking education.
- [Reentry Financial Literacy & Empowerment](https://medleyinnovation.com/reentry-empowerment.html): Banking access, credit rebuilding, and workforce reintegration after incarceration.
- [Digital Banking Education](https://medleyinnovation.com/digital-banking.html): Online and mobile banking, digital payments, and fraud prevention.

## Key facts
- Location: Las Vegas, Nevada (in person across Southern Nevada; nationwide via Zoom)
- Funding: WIOA-aligned and structured for grant funding (CDFI Fund, HUD, CRA, SBA, CSBG)
- Audiences: workforce agencies, employers, nonprofits, CDFIs, banks, and underserved communities
- Contact: support@medleyinnovation.com
